about: Leonida Ledger — an offline GTA VI trophy guide and tracker. Trophy names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's official text, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Every guide below is original writing for this entry. Where a step comes from a published launch-week guide it is cited; where no published guide confirms a location or method, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

roadmap.title: Chapter 1 — play, and save
roadmap.text: Finish the opening mission and Chapter 1, beat Cal at fishing, finish one arcade game, and do Lucia's balcony meditation while it is available. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay, so a chapter-start save is your only way back.

roadmap.title: Chapters 2–4 — the story
roadmap.text: Play the story through to the final mission. Character switching opens in Chapter 2, which unlocks the partner trophies and the stranger strands. Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3 — it is time-sensitive. Finish the six side-story finales (Andy, Billy, Kenton, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) whenever they appear; they stay open after the credits.

roadmap.title: Robberies and partner feats
roadmap.text: Once the robbery tools arrive in Chapters 3 and 4 — the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, then the bank-vault job near the end of Chapter 4 — take the robbery trophies and the partner feats that ride along with them, including the 4-star escape that also clears Hot Together.

roadmap.title: Open-world sweep
roadmap.text: After the credits, everything outside the story stays open: collectibles (cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles, areas), races, shooting ranges, stunts, Challenges and the money trophies. Work them in any order and let the progress counters in this tracker do the counting.

roadmap.title: 100% and the platinum
roadmap.text: The 100% checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but work done earlier still counts. It needs more than the trophies do — 300 stunts instead of 250, 70 of 80 Challenges, all 8 bank vaults, 200 of 277 vehicle models — so keep grinding past each trophy pop until A Long Road lands, and Vice Got a Price! follows.

saveRules: There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus at launch: once a story mission is done you cannot select it again.
Keep one manual save at the start of every chapter, plus one untouched save from just before the final mission. The game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave.
Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — it is the one confirmed missable and it disappears when the chapter ends.
Do Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 as soon as it appears; it carries an hourglass icon and is time-sensitive.
Never test cheats on your trophy save: cheats are expected to switch off trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the reward for everything else: it pops the moment the 54th other trophy lands, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Follow the roadmap in order — story first with a save at every chapter start, then the robbery and partner feats, then the open-world sweep — and finish with the 100% checklist, which is the longest single job at roughly 200 hours for the whole platinum. No online, difficulty or medal trophy stands in the way; it is long, not hard.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Leave A Long Road (100% Completion) for last — it is the longest grind.
Check the tracker above: when 54 of 55 are ticked, this one is next.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first trophy most players will earn: play through it and the trophy pops when it ends. It is unmissable — you cannot pass the opening without finishing it — and it also teaches the fishing you will need later to beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Before you leave the chapter, do the one thing in it that never comes back: Lucia's balcony meditation, which counts toward Positive Mental Attitude. Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 and keep it until that trophy pops, since there is no mission replay. The chapter trophy itself can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it is a beat late.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 1.
Do Lucia's balcony meditation while the chapter is still open (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Finish the chapter's missions; the trophy pops at the chapter's end.

Make a manual save at the chapter's start, as with every chapter, and work the side content that appears instead of rushing past it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. Two things in this chapter deserve attention while you are here: the Snap Gun arrives with the mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which opens jewelry store robberies for Sneakthief, and the street race against Yago is time-sensitive — do it the moment it appears, with a save made first, because it feeds a stranger strand that counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Save at the chapter's start as usual.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 3.
Do Race Against Yago as soon as it appears (save first).
Play the chapter through, including Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

Near the end of this chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is unlocks bank vaults, which is the gateway to Maximum Withdrawal and the robbery trophies around it — do that mission before the finale if it is offered. Keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission: with no mission replay, that save is your only way back to it.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 4.
Do the optional mission That's Where The Money Is when it appears.
Keep an untouched save from just before the final mission, then finish the chapter.

Play and finish the final mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the second gold, and the longest single job in the game. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but work done earlier still counts. Its bars sit above the individual trophies: 300 stunts instead of 250, 70 of the 80 Challenges, all 8 bank vaults, 200 of the 277 vehicle models, all 39 illegal operations. Do the story first, then grind the checklist in the open world; expect the whole platinum to take around 200 hours, most of it here.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Clear every line of the checklist — stunts, Challenges, vaults, vehicles, operations.
The trophy pops at 100%; the platinum follows with it.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps all count, so mix them rather than grinding one kind. The counter runs from the start of the game, so stunts you pull while playing the story already count. Do not stop at 250: the 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past the pop if you want A Long Road.
steps: Pull stunts as you play — jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights, base jumps.
Watch the counter; the trophy pops at 250.
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. This is a sampler, not a grind: one taste of everything the open world offers — a race, a fishing trip, an arcade game, a shooting range session, a drone race, a stunt, a meditation spot, a gym session, a bowling game, whatever the nine turn out to be in your run. It pops as soon as the ninth type is tried, and most players will clear it by accident while chasing the other activity trophies.
steps: Play one of each activity type the game offers (9 in total).
Check what you have tried; fill the gaps with a single quick session each.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across two shooting ranges. This is a skill trophy, not a grind: each challenge has its own gold threshold, so replay a challenge until the medal turns gold and move on. Bring your best aim and a steady trigger finger; there is no difficulty trophy in the game, so the ranges are the same for everyone.
steps: Find a shooting range (there are two).
Play each challenge and chase the gold medal threshold.
Replay any challenge that lands silver or bronze until all 42 are gold.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

Fly the drone courses cleanly and learn each course's turns; a win at a location you have already won does not advance the counter, so track which locations are left in this tracker.
steps: Find the Top Fun Drone Race locations across Leonida (14 in total).
Win at least one race at each location.
The trophy pops when the 14th location is won.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word: winning the same race twice counts once, so you need 20 distinct race events across the map — street races, and any other race types the game offers. The Yago street race strand in Chapter 3 counts toward this too, so do the races as they appear rather than leaving them all for the endgame.
steps: Enter races across Leonida — street races and any other race types.
Win 20 different race events (repeats do not count).
Check the counter after each win; the trophy pops at 20.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. THE missable: one spot is Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time), follow her out to the balcony of Jason's house and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and it is not confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
steps: In Chapter 1: do Lucia's balcony meditation (morning, after Down to Earth) — do not skip it.
Meditate at every other spot (18 total), bringing your partner so outdoor spots count twice.
Keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.missableNote: MISSABLE — the one confirmed missable in the game. Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears when the chapter ends. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game phone app for scanning and tagging places — open it at landmarks, businesses and viewpoints across Leonida and the location counts. It pairs naturally with the other map-clearing trophies: while you sweep for the 52 areas of The Goodtime State and the 100 vehicles of Whip It Good, WAiNK each spot you pass. One hundred locations is a lot, so fold it into your general map sweep instead of grinding it alone.
steps: Open the WAiNK app at a location to tag it.
WAiNK new locations as you sweep the map for areas and vehicles.
The trophy pops at 100 locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play — driving, fighting, exploring and collecting all feed them. Do not grind them first: play the rest of the list and check the Challenges screen regularly, then mop up the easiest unfinished ones at the end. The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so keep going past 50 if you want A Long Road.
steps: Open Progress > Challenges to see the list.

Mop up the easiest unfinished Challenges until 50 are done; keep going to 70 for 100%.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose it completely. The easiest honest route is a bank vault job: vaults give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, and escaping one with your partner also earns this. Note the timing — it only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area — so keep driving until the stars are fully gone.
steps: Bring your partner (switching opens in Chapter 2).
Build a 4-star Wanted Level — a bank vault job does it at once.
Escape until the stars clear completely and you are out of the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row without losing your Wanted Level. The trick is the opposite of a normal escape: keep the police chasing you the whole time. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks — so move fast between shops and do not hide. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
steps: Call your partner in.
Rob a shop, then a second and a third, back to back.
Keep the Wanted Level alive the whole time — do not let the stars fade.
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop for the pop.

The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.

Cover varied districts so you meet different models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Set it up rather than hoping for it — pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle so each shot lands fast. Adrenaline extends Focus, so use it to stretch the window until the fifth enemy drops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense

PowerPyx lists Capital Offense as currently unknown, Outputlag groups it with the five hidden trophies that have no confirmed method, and GTABase says the exact steps aren't confirmed. So experiment in free roam: drive a car into a Vice City showroom, then accelerate out through the window instead of the door. If one showroom does not register, try another — and try leaving in one of the showroom's own display cars, since 'in classic style' may mean stealing a car off the floor on the way out. It is a repeatable stunt, not a story moment: free roam continues after the credits and no guide flags it as missable. Keep a manual save before you start breaking glass — expect a wanted level — and reload if an attempt gets expensive.

Accelerate out through the glass front — not through the door.
No pop? Try another showroom, and try exiting in one of its display cars.
Keep a manual save first; expect a wanted level.
